scenes.tts: If warming quiets the cool line, what happens to warmth when that line is gone?
scenes.visual: Title card: Take Away the Cool Line. Then the cool fibre's raster from chapter one, fading out. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: If warming quiets the cool line, what happens to warmth when that line is gone?

scenes.tts: First, the task. A head-fixed mouse rests a forepaw on a small plate at thirty-two degrees. It licks to report a change.
scenes.caption: First, the task. A head-fixed mouse rests a forepaw on a small plate at 32 degrees. It licks to report a change.
scenes.visual: A head-fixed mouse with a lick spout; one forepaw on a small square Peltier plate. Labels: 8 × 8 mm, 32 °C baseline. The plate's temperature trace steps up; a lick mark appears at the spout.
scenes.narration: First, the task. A head-fixed mouse rests a forepaw on a small plate at 32 degrees. It licks to report a change.

scenes.tts: Trained mice reported a warming step of one degree.
scenes.caption: Trained mice reported a warming step of 1 degree.
scenes.visual: On-screen: warming group, 1 °C step reported; a separate cooling group, 0.5 °C step reported.
scenes.narration: Trained mice reported a warming step of 1 degree.

scenes.tts: A mouse that licked on every trial would score hits without detecting anything.
scenes.visual: A mouse licking at every trial marker; a tally of hits fills up regardless of the stimulus.
scenes.narration: A mouse that licked on every trial would score hits without detecting anything.

scenes.tts: So some trials are catch trials, with no temperature change. A lick then is a false alarm.
scenes.visual: Trial markers split into two rows: warming trials and catch trials with a flat temperature trace. Licks on catch trials are tagged false alarm.
scenes.narration: So some trials are catch trials, with no temperature change. A lick then is a false alarm.

scenes.tts: An index called d prime compares the two. It separates detection from how freely the mouse licks.
scenes.caption: An index called d′ compares the two. It separates detection from how freely the mouse licks.
scenes.visual: Formula on screen: d′ = z(hit rate) − z(false-alarm rate). Example on screen only: 80 of 100 hits, 20 of 100 false alarms, d′ about 1.68.
scenes.narration: An index called d′ compares the two. It separates detection from how freely the mouse licks.

scenes.tts: Licking as often on catch trials as on warming trials gives a d prime near zero.
scenes.caption: Licking as often on catch trials as on warming trials gives a d′ near zero.
scenes.visual: Second tally on screen: 80 of 100 hits and 80 of 100 false alarms; d′ about 0. Label: licking, not detecting.
scenes.narration: Licking as often on catch trials as on warming trials gives a d′ near zero.

scenes.tts: Now the knockouts. T R P M eight is the main channel behind the cool fibres' response to cooling.
scenes.caption: Now the knockouts. TRPM8 is the main channel behind the cool fibres' response to cooling.
scenes.visual: The cool fibre returns with a TRPM8 channel icon on its ending.
scenes.narration: Now the knockouts. TRPM8 is the main channel behind the cool fibres' response to cooling.

scenes.tts: Remove it. What happens to the cool fibres' resting firing? And can the mouse still report warming?
scenes.visual: The TRPM8 icon is crossed out. Question on screen: resting firing? reports of warming?
scenes.narration: Remove it. What happens to the cool fibres' resting firing? And can the mouse still report warming?

scenes.tts: Without T R P M eight, the cool fibres lose their ongoing firing. Warming has nothing left to silence.
scenes.caption: Without TRPM8, the cool fibres lose their ongoing firing. Warming has nothing left to silence.
scenes.visual: The cool fibre's raster is empty at rest and stays empty under the warming bar.
scenes.narration: Without TRPM8, the cool fibres lose their ongoing firing. Warming has nothing left to silence.

scenes.tts: And the mice failed completely to report warming, even after ten days of training.
scenes.caption: And the mice failed completely to report warming, even after 10 days of training.
scenes.visual: A table starts to build. Row: no TRPM8; cool fibres' ongoing firing, lost; reports warming, no, failed completely after 10 days.
scenes.narration: And the mice failed completely to report warming, even after 10 days of training.

scenes.tts: Not because heat opens T R P M eight. Removing it removes the firing whose fall is part of the warmth signal.
scenes.caption: Not because heat opens TRPM8. Removing it removes the firing whose fall is part of the warmth signal.
scenes.visual: Small note on screen: TRPM8 is not heat-gated here; it supplies the firing that warming reduces.
scenes.narration: Not because heat opens TRPM8. Removing it removes the firing whose fall is part of the warmth signal.

scenes.tts: Now remove heat channels instead. Mice without T R P V one, or without T R P M two, still detected warming.
scenes.caption: Now remove heat channels instead. Mice without TRPV1, or without TRPM2, still detected warming.
scenes.visual: Two more table rows: no TRPV1, yes, blunted, still detects 1 °C; no TRPM2, yes, blunted, threshold 2 °C. Table header: reports warming in this task?
scenes.narration: Now remove heat channels instead. Mice without TRPV1, or without TRPM2, still detected warming.

scenes.tts: Even mice lacking three heat channels still detected warming, with reduced sensitivity. Heat-channel loss blunts. T R P M eight loss abolished the cold report in this task.
scenes.visual: Another row: no TRPV1, TRPA1 or TRPM3; reports warming, yes, reduced sensitivity, no threshold given. Then the finished table, with the TRPM8 row highlighted.
scenes.narration: Even mice lacking three heat channels still detected warming, with reduced sensitivity. Heat-channel loss blunts. TRPM8 loss abolishes.
scenes.caption: Even mice lacking three heat channels still detected warming, with reduced sensitivity. Heat-channel loss blunts. TRPM8 loss abolishes.

scenes.tts: And T R P M eight knockout mice still had warm-excited fibres, in normal proportions.
scenes.visual: The TRPM8-null mouse's skin: the cool fibre dark, the warm-excited fibre still present and firing under a warming bar. Label: warm-excited fibres present, proportions similar to wild type.
scenes.narration: And TRPM8 knockout mice still had warm-excited fibres, in normal proportions.
scenes.caption: And TRPM8 knockout mice still had warm-excited fibres, in normal proportions.

scenes.tts: If each line alone were enough to drive a report, the remaining warm responses should have supported one. In these mice, they did not.
scenes.visual: Two alarm icons, cool line and warm line, under the label: discarded model, each line independently sufficient. The cool alarm is removed and the warm alarm still rings, but the output stays dark. Label: no measurable warming report.
scenes.narration: If each line alone were enough to drive a report, the remaining warm responses should have supported one. In these mice, they did not.

scenes.tts: The findings support a role for reduced cool input. Warm-excited input may also contribute, but its separate effect on sensitivity was not isolated.
scenes.visual: Two inputs, cool-line fall and warm-line rise, both enter one box. Label on the box: how they combine, unknown.
scenes.narration: The findings support a role for reduced cool input. Warm-excited input may also contribute, but its separate effect on sensitivity was not isolated.

scenes.tts: How the brain combines the two lines is not known.
scenes.visual: On-screen text: two lines, one report; the computation is unknown. A question mark sits on the box.
scenes.narration: How the brain combines the two lines is not known.

scenes.tts: One gap remains. The resting cool firing was recorded in isolated skin, not in a behaving mouse.
scenes.visual: Split screen: left, the isolated skin patch, labelled 27 °C bath, 32 °C Peltier baseline; right, the mouse on its 32 °C plate.
scenes.narration: One gap remains. The resting cool firing was recorded in isolated skin, not in a behaving mouse.

scenes.tts: The skin under the stimulator sat at the same thirty-two degrees. Joining the two is still an inference, not a recording.
scenes.caption: The skin under the stimulator sat at the same 32 degrees. Joining the two is still an inference, not a recording.
scenes.visual: A dashed bridge joins the panels, labelled: isolated skin to behaving mouse, inferred.
scenes.narration: The skin under the stimulator sat at the same 32 degrees. Joining the two is still an inference, not a recording.

scenes.tts: Another preparation points the other way. In mouth-warming experiments, blocking T R P V one removed the imaged warmth responses.
scenes.caption: Another preparation points the other way. In mouth-warming experiments, blocking TRPV1 removed the imaged warmth responses.
scenes.visual: A trigeminal ganglion with glowing cell bodies during oral warming; after a TRPV1 blocker, the warm responses fade. Labels: anaesthetized mice, acute drug block, 2016.
scenes.narration: Another preparation points the other way. In mouth-warming experiments, blocking TRPV1 removed the imaged warmth responses.

scenes.tts: So does gentle warmth rest mainly on warm fibres, or on quieter cool fibres? That is not settled.
scenes.visual: Two labelled options side by side: TRPV1-positive warm fibres; reduced TRPM8-dependent cool input. A balance between them, level.
scenes.narration: So does gentle warmth rest mainly on warm fibres, or on quieter cool fibres? That is not settled.

scenes.tts: Keep the bath in mind. A resting condition is part of the stimulus, not a neutral background.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the cool fibre firing at rest, with the words: the resting condition is part of the stimulus.
scenes.narration: Keep the bath in mind. A resting condition is part of the stimulus, not a neutral background.
